activate.title: Activate NextHubX
activate.subtitle: Enter your account email and activation code to activate
activate.resetNotice: This device has been reset or your seat is no longer valid. Please reactivate with your activation code.
activate.resetNoticeWithEmail: Account {{email}} has been reset or is no longer valid. Please reactivate with this account's email and activation code; contact your administrator for a new code.

verify.verifying: Verifying exit IP… (usually completes within ~15 seconds after TUN switches)
verify.mismatchHint: Exit IP check in progress: the detected exit has not switched to your assigned exit yet, which is normal during the transition. Your account will appear automatically once verified; if it takes longer than a minute, check your connection or contact support.

feedback.empty: Please enter your account email and activation code
feedback.invalid: Email or activation code is incorrect, or the code has already been used/expired. Double-check the account email and code from your administrator, then retry. If you activated on another device, contact your administrator to reset it.
feedback.networkError: Network error, please try again later
feedback.unknown: Activation failed, please try again later

service.guideBody: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to create a global proxy adapter. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is only required once.

fallback.title: Fell back to system proxy mode
fallback.body: The network service is not installed or permission was denied, so system proxy mode is used. Traffic from apps that ignore proxy settings may bypass the proxy.

gate.title: TUN network service required
gate.body: NextHubX needs to install a background network service to create the TUN virtual adapter and take over global traffic. The system will request administrator privileges (UAC on Windows / password on macOS). This is required only once; the app cannot be used until it is installed.
gate.supportBody: The network service could not be installed after several attempts. Please contact technical support for help and provide your system information.

account.title: Account
account.empty: No account information yet, please activate first

usage.title: How to use this account
usage.body: Use the Google account above (email + password) to sign in to the team services provisioned for you. Do not change the password, bind a personal phone number, or enable two-factor authentication, and do not use it for personal purposes. This account is for your work use only; contact your administrator if you run into sign-in issues.

sync.revokedNotice: This device has been reset or your seat is no longer valid. Please reactivate with your activation code.

exitGuard.title: Exit IP mismatch
exitGuard.body: The current exit IP ({{actual}}) does not match your assigned exit ({{expected}}). Your traffic may be leaving through the wrong exit. Please check your connection or contact technical support.
exitGuard.notifyBody: Current exit ({{actual}}) differs from your assigned exit ({{expected}}). Please open NextHubX and check your connection.

clashVergeConflict.title: Clash Verge conflict detected
clashVergeConflict.runningBody: Clash Verge is running and will compete with NextHubX for the same network service, causing your connections to keep dropping. Please fully close it by following these steps:
clashVergeConflict.appearedBody: Clash Verge has just started and will disconnect your connection. Please fully close it by following these steps:
clashVergeConflict.blockingActivate: Before activating, fully close Clash Verge (turn off TUN, turn off launch-at-startup, then quit) — otherwise the connections conflict. Follow the steps below and retry:
